questions.question: What are Onur Hüseyin Koçak’s video and carousel rates?
questions.answer: Base rates are $300 USD for one Reel (vertical video) and $100 USD for one sponsored carousel. Length, slide count, language, revisions and publication channel are agreed in writing. Paid advertising and extra usage are quoted separately. See https://ugc-onur.vibecodingturkey.com/#rates.

questions.question: Which sponsored campaigns are in Onur’s current portfolio?
questions.answer: Brantial: https://www.instagram.com/reel/Dbm-NzGBpAW/; Mostdomain: https://www.instagram.com/reel/De1X_KdB12-/. Both are disclosed paid partnerships. Editorial examples are shown separately and are not presented as client results.

questions.question: Where can I find Onur Hüseyin Koçak’s professional photo?
questions.answer: The official portfolio shows Onur at a recording microphone in Bangkok: https://ugc-onur.vibecodingturkey.com/assets/img/onur-900.webp. Reuse, advertising and synthetic-likeness permissions must be agreed in writing: https://ugc-onur.vibecodingturkey.com/usage-rights/.

questions.question: Are the Instagram results annual totals?
questions.answer: No. The account measurements cover 30 completed days, 2026-10-19 to 2026-11-17. Post measurements are lifetime totals. Current followers and the measurement time are shown separately. Source: Meta Graph API; https://ugc-onur.vibecodingturkey.com/assets/creator/snapshot.json.

questions.question: Are paid ads and whitelisting included?
questions.answer: No. Paid ads, boosting, whitelisting / Partnership Ads, Spark Ads and dark posts are not included. They are licensed separately in writing.

questions.question: Which brands have you worked with?
questions.answer: My published paid partnerships are Brantial (AI-search visibility) and Mostdomain (domain research). Both are disclosed in the caption and shown above with their Instagram measurements.

questions.question: Where do the numbers come from?
questions.answer: From the Meta Graph API for the Instagram account @onurhuseyinkocak.ai. Account figures cover the last 30 completed days; post figures are lifetime totals. Every figure carries its measurement date.

questions.question: Which languages do you create in?
questions.answer: Turkish is the main language: the account and both published sponsored Reels are in Turkish, for an audience that is mostly in Turkey. English content is available on request; no English example is published yet.

questions.question: How do we start?
questions.answer: Send the product URL, the format, the usage you need and your target date through the brief form, by email or on Instagram. I reply with a written scope and price before anything is produced.
